title: Which operation do you undo first?
text: $$2x + 5$$ adds 5 after doubling $$x$$. Equations are undone in reverse, so remove the $$+ 5$$ before you divide by 2. A common mistake is to divide 17 by 2 first and then not know what to do with the 5. What is $$17 - 5$$?

title: Divide both sides by the coefficient
Worked solution
text: $$2x + 5 = 17$$. Subtract 5: $$2x = 12$$. Divide by 2: $$x = 6$$. Check: $$2(6) + 5 = 17$$. Common mistake: dividing before subtracting, which splits the 5 incorrectly if you are not careful. General rule: undo addition or subtraction first, then undo multiplication or division. Do the same thing to both sides at every step.
